[USER] User wants to know about common misconceptions regarding bodybuilding and weightlifting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weightlifting makes women bulky: Women don't have enough testosterone to build huge muscles without supplements; it helps sculpt muscles for a leaner physique.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weightlifting isn't safe: It can be dangerous if not done correctly, but proper technique and training can ensure safety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cardio is more important than lifting: Both cardio and weightlifting are important for overall fitness; combining both yields the best results.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lifting heavy weights is the only way to build muscle: Building muscle involves nutrition, rest, and progressive overload, not just heavy lifting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bodybuilding is only for men: Bodybuilding is for everyone, including women, and is about shaping muscles, not just bulking up.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Correcting misconceptions involves educating about proper lifting techniques, combining cardio and weightlifting, and recognizing bodybuilding is not gender-specific.
